readingObservations.allocationEvidence: Digital Daijisen's actual れつ【劣】 character heading gives 音レツ and explicitly lists 優劣. The actual ゆう‐れつ【優劣】 word heading and complete JMdict1539620 establish the selected spelling/reading. This does not rely on merely matching a kana substring.
readingObservations.usefulness: A relative-merits noun provides an uncontracted レツ example alongside the useful native comparison verb. The current collection has no 優劣 article, and the complete family has noun sense 'relative merits; superiority or inferiority; quality'.
readingObservations.qualification: 優劣 includes both sides of comparison, not inferiority alone. Contrast 優's superiority contribution with 劣's inferiority contribution; a quality comparison need not rank people's intrinsic worth. No spelling-priority flag is treated as a measured frequency.

readingObservations.allocationEvidence: Actual Digital Daijisen おと・る【劣る】 heading confirms spelling and boundary; JMdict1558400 retains the complete intransitive godan family. Existing article teaches the same primary lexical identity and explicit negative 劣らない.
readingObservations.usefulness: Existing N3 article supplies useful comparison syntax without duplicating an article or assigning a harder vocabulary level.
readingObservations.qualification: The kanji preserves raw おと.る; the question key is おとる. Favorable negatives and comparison dimensions should remain separate from a universal claim that 劣る means losing a contest. Historical age/rank/decrease senses in other dictionaries are not automatically modern neutral teaching examples.

fullFamilyRestrictionNotes: 1482820 preserves 卑劣 and rare-kanji-spelling 鄙劣; rarity attaches to the spelling, not automatically to ひれつ pronunciation.
1558420 劣化 has a separate colloquial visible-aging/becoming-unattractive sense; neutral technical deterioration does not license describing people without the qualification.
1558500 劣性 is distinct from homophonous1558480 劣勢. Genetic recessiveness is not a teaching claim of inferior human worth; no genetics support article is required for this batch.

1539620 優劣 is an unrestricted noun family with the selected ゆうれつ reading. The historical ましおとり heading in Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten is not a replacement primary reading or a reason to expand the frozen kanji reading list.
1847520 負けず劣らず,1909440 優るとも劣らない/勝るとも劣らない,1909450 勝るとも劣らぬ/優るとも劣らぬ and2181830 に劣らず preserve favorable/equal comparison uses; polarity matters.
2108410 preserves two recognized spellings 優劣つけがたい/優劣付け難い and two search-only aliases 優劣付けがたい/優劣つけ難い. Search aliases do not become ordinary spelling examples.
2475990 standalone 劣れつ is a mathematics prefix family, not evidence for an unrestricted conversational noun or adjective.
2650800 劣機 carries a Buddhism field.2731140 劣等種 and2744890 劣等人種 carry sensitive flags; neither is needed as a useful example or support article.
2842412 上げ劣り is archaic;2846415 庸劣 and2852283 心劣り are rare-term families. Their dictionary recognition is not evidence that they are everyday expressions.

The public character page also has classical standalone れつ and おとり dictionary blocks and Jitsu's broader historical gloss/readings. They do not change the frozen KANJIDIC2 reading list or establish useful modern quiz prompts.
